2. To get lapis lazuli, you can craft 1 from 1 lapis lazuli. So, to make 9 lapis lazuli, you need to craft 9 times.
3. This means gathering 9 lapis lazuli blocks.

5. Since you need 9 lapis lazuli, gather 9 scratchable materials.
6. Create 9 lapis lazuli blocks by crafting 1 blue dye (which uses 1 lapis lazuli) 9 times.
7. Now that you have enough lapis lazuli blocks, you can craft a lapis block using 9 of them.

    - Craft 1 lapis lazuli using the scratchable material.
    - Repeat step 1-2 three more times to gain 8 more lapis lazuli, making a total of 9 lapis lazuli.
    - Combine 9 lapis lazuli to craft 1 lapis block.

Remember, if you have scratchable materials lying around, like coal dust, you can craft multiple lapis lazuli from those before gathering the extra lapis lazuli you need.
